reason_for_followup: Full Oracle vector correction reduced speed in all ten pairs and caused no added damage, but three pairs exceeded the 0.5 m lateral-error guard. Isolate the longitudinal action dimensions rather than training a full action imitation target.
hypothesis: Replacing only policy throttle/brake with the immutable Oracle throttle/brake, while retaining policy steering, preserves the speed improvement without worsening lateral error or damage.

intervention.branch_state: replay exact current-runtime saved policy prefix; require observation hash, position, speed and Oracle action to match the saved precursor state within 1e-5
intervention.after_event: same three saved policy actions in both branches

measured_outcome.primary: treatment minus control speed after four decisions
measured_outcome.speed_gate: delta <= -0.5 m/s in at least 8 of 10 pairs
measured_outcome.lane_guard: absolute center-error increase <= 0.5 m in every pair
measured_outcome.decision_rule: advance only to a masked throttle/brake Oracle-supervision pilot if all gates pass; otherwise reject longitudinal-only imitation and prioritize steering/heading-state diagnosis

scope.geometry_partition: already consumed RLPD G0 TRAIN cells

resource_contract.active_training_overlap: these G0 cells are already used by the reused-TRAIN learner; preserve its outputs and use one low-priority thread

command: nice -n 19 env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m scripts.branch_oracle_longitudinal_action
